construction: Authored pants geometry generated from a continuous joined leg/seat volume with cargo panels, waistband, belt loops, fly/button, cuff channels and drawcord details.

referenceSource.role: Silhouette reference only; no source geometry, texture, logo or label carried into the authored garment.

uv.coverage: All authored mesh vertices have UVs; panel details use local panel coordinates and body uses a planar world-space projection.
uv.limitations: Front/back UV overlap is not intended for artwork placement; current shape review uses a solid neutral material. Material should preserve the UVs and avoid artwork placement until QA shape pass.

displayEnvelopeCm.source: tools/showcase-glb.mjs primitives() world-space bounds of authored GLB
displayEnvelopeCm.meaning: Display envelope only, not apparel or sewing size.

review.previewCaption: Geometry quần cargo được dựng độc lập; JNCO chỉ tham chiếu silhouette, không kế thừa geometry, logo hoặc nhãn.
